NEW_1.caption: Template ID
NEW_1.doc: Starts with 'tpl_'. Find it in your DocSpring account, or with Find Templates.
NEW_1.name: templateId

NEW_2.caption: Template Version
NEW_2.doc: Optional. A published version such as 1.2.0 (or 1 for the latest 1.x.x), latest, or draft. Default: the latest published version (the draft when none has been published).
NEW_2.name: version

NEW_3.caption: Data
NEW_3.doc: The values of the template's fields, by field name. Use '/' for nested fields and lists, such as 'address/city' or 'items/0/name'. Date fields take dates as YYYY-MM-DD. For an image field, use 'image_name/url' with an image URL.
NEW_3.name: data

NEW_4.caption: Enable Booleans
NEW_4.doc: If enabled, any fields with the exact value of "true" or "false" will be parsed as booleans (true and false) instead of as text.
NEW_4.name: parseAsBoolean

NEW_5.caption: Test Mode
NEW_5.doc: Test PDFs are free, but they include watermarks. A test API token always makes test PDFs.
NEW_5.name: test

NEW_6.caption: Metadata
NEW_6.doc: Your own data about the record, such as an ID from your app. It isn't printed on the PDF, and it's sent with webhooks.
NEW_6.name: metadata

NEW_7.caption: Signer Name
NEW_7.doc: The name of the person who signs.
NEW_7.name: signerName

NEW_9.caption: Signer Role
NEW_9.doc: Optional. Which of the template's signers they are: Signer 1, Signer 2 and so on. Either every signer has a role or none does.
NEW_9.name: signerRole

NEW_10.caption: Signer Fields
NEW_10.doc: The names of the fields this person fills in and signs, separated by commas, such as "signature, date_signed".
NEW_10.name: signerFields

NEW_11.caption: Auth Type
NEW_11.doc: How your app checked who the person is before showing them the signature request.
NEW_11.name: authType

NEW_12.caption: Auth Provider
NEW_12.doc: The service that authenticated them, such as google. Required when Auth Type is oauth.
NEW_12.name: authProvider

NEW_13.caption: Prefilled Values Editable
NEW_13.doc: Let the signer change values that Data already fills in for their fields.
NEW_13.name: prefilledValuesEditable

NEW_14.caption: Ignore Unknown Fields
NEW_14.doc: Leave out Signer Fields names that the template doesn't have.
NEW_14.name: ignoreUnknownFields

NEW_15.caption: More Signers (JSON)
NEW_15.doc: Optional, advanced. A JSON list of more signers, added after the signer above, such as [{"name": "Jane", "email": "jane@example.com", "fields": ["signature_2"], "auth_type": "email_link"}].
NEW_15.name: signatureRequests

NEW_16.caption: Signing Link Type
NEW_16.doc: Make a signing link for each signer: api (opens for 24 hours, for your app to show now), email (7 days, to send), or none.
NEW_16.name: signingLinkType
